candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing at the order call with '500 Internal Server Error' from http://order:8000/v1/orders, so the gateway 502s are downstream order failures rather than gateway faults.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order (db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, bad-configuration) is not established; order-side logs were excluded from context.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show checkout 502s caused by order returning 500 on /v1/orders across all correlation IDs; topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Deployment record only shows gateway 1.0.0 baseline and does not establish deployment-caused latency. The specific order-side fault is not yet bounded, so the candidate is scoped to the observed http-500 at order.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/errors explaining the 500 on /v1/orders
Order dependency health (postgresql, payment, inventory/redis) metrics or traces
Latency/error metrics for order and its dependencies during the incident window
